session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Double Bottom, Then Bear Channel'. Higher low double bottoms at 5958 launch a wedge rally to the double top breakout level 5998, a lower high double top at 5990 with failed later attempts extends the evening, and the bear channel obligation sells down through the green dotted 5958 line to 5932.
